summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase workflow end-to-end for cipher-box Phase 68 (Web Integration: Rotation UX and Durable Client State) — research the domain, generate PLAN.md files, and verify them before execution.
summary.outcome: Produced RESEARCH.md, VALIDATION.md, PATTERNS.md, and 9 PLAN.md files across 3 waves, all committed; plan-checker verification passed with 3 non-blocking warnings, 2 of which were fixed inline (missing 68-08→68-02 dependency, unresolved RESEARCH.md open questions); requirement/decision coverage gates passed (ROT-07, all 5 success criteria, WRITE-03, D-01–D-13); phase marked ready for /gsd-execute-phase 68.

repo: Rotation logic must be wired into packages/sdk/src/client.ts mutation methods (renameItem, moveItem, deleteItem, deleteToBin), not into the thin web React hooks which just call client.X() methods.
executeLazyRotation has zero live callers (deletion path is effectively free); addShareKeys/reWrapForRecipients do have callers in useAuth.ts and useSharedNavigation.ts that need rerouting.

share.service.ts's fetchReceivedShares/fetchSentShares are stub functions that unconditionally throw — no real data path exists yet for rootGeneration seeding despite the generated API client already exposing the needed fields.

reMintGrantsRootedAt's updateGrantFn has no backing API endpoint; shares.controller.ts lacks a PATCH route for readDescriptorRef/rootGeneration, requiring a new apps/api route plus `pnpm api:generate`.
No `idb` npm package anywhere in the repo — all IndexedDB usage follows a hand-rolled raw-indexedDB Promise-wrapping pattern (see identity.ts, search-index.service.ts).
apps/web/vitest.config.ts only includes src/**/*.test.ts and runs with environment: 'node' — there is no IndexedDB test shim (fake-indexeddb) in place yet, a Wave 0 gap.
navigator.locks (used for multi-tab leader election, D-09) has no prior usage anywhere in this codebase — first-time pattern with no analog.
New apps/api PATCH routes should mirror updateShareItemName/UpdateItemNameDto exactly: ownership check via sharerId, class-validator decorators, HttpCode(204).

GSD commit_failed messages can be false negatives — always verify with git status/tracked-file check rather than trusting the reported failure (happened for both VALIDATION.md and PATTERNS.md commits).

code.finding: Existing anti-clobber sequenceNumber guard; Phase 68 needs to reuse this with inverted polarity for D-04 rotation logic.
renameItem — rotation must be wired in here.
moveItem — rotation must be wired in here.
deleteItem — rotation must be wired in here.
deleteToBin — rotation must be wired in here.

workflow: Subagent spawns (researcher, pattern-mapper, planner, plan-checker) produce zero output until they complete (~1–5 min each) — this is expected and the orchestrator should just wait for the task-notification rather than treating silence as a hang.

Plan-checker warnings should be triaged individually: fix cheap, genuinely-blocking-adjacent ones (plan-graph dependency correctness) immediately; defer ones tied to a later execution milestone (VALIDATION.md frontmatter flips) rather than fixing prematurely.
Coverage gates (requirements, decision coverage) can silently produce no output on first run — worth re-running cleanly to confirm the actual pass/fail result rather than assuming failure.

friction: commit_failed false-negative reported twice (VALIDATION.md, then PATTERNS.md commits) requiring manual git-tracked verification each time.
Decision coverage gate produced no output on first invocation, requiring a second clean re-run to confirm the 13/13 pass result.
open_items: VALIDATION.md frontmatter (nyquist_compliant: false, wave_0_complete: false, Approval: pending) intentionally left unreconciled until Wave 0 (plan 68-01) executes and closes the IndexedDB test-shim gap.

Two scope gaps surfaced by research (share.service.ts fetch stubs; missing apps/api grant PATCH endpoint) are planned as explicit tasks (68-02, 68-03) but not yet executed — next step is /gsd-execute-phase 68.
Open question on exact API route shape for D-10/D-11 grant re-mint persistence (single-grant PATCH vs batch/indexed endpoint) was resolved via recommendation only, not implemented/validated yet.
